newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria to host NATO peacekeeping exercise.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria to host NATO peacekeeping exercise.

text.p: Staff officers from eight nations including the United States and Italy will gather in the Bulgarian capital on Saturday to take part in an exercise dubbed Peaceful Eagle 97 as part of NATO's Partnership for Peace programme.

Bulgarian Major General Petko Dragoev said Albania, Greece, Macedonia, Romania and Turkey would also participate in the exercise in Sofia, which will be the first of its kind and will last until May 22.

The United States will contribute computer experts and equipment for an exercise based on the situation in Bosnia and the activities of the NATO-led Implementation Force, defence ministry officials said.
Bulgaria, like most of the ex-communist countries including Russia, is a member of the Partnership for Peace programme which aims to build cooperation between NATO and its former Cold War foes.

Earlier this year Bulgaria declared its desire for full NATO membership. NATO is due to hold a summit in Madrid in July at which it is expected to invite several former eastern bloc countries to join.
